domain-information: A Driver completes a scheduled route and reports minor delays to the dispatcher.
A Driver performs a pre-trip check and changes the status of the vehicle if there are any issues.
A Dispatcher assigns vehicles to drivers based on the daily service plan.
A Dispatcher monitors route progress and contacts drivers when significant delays occur.
A Dispatcher submits an incident report to operations management after service disruptions.
A Maintenance Technician inspects a vehicle that was flagged by a driver during pre-trip checks.
A Maintenance Technician completes routine servicing and updates the maintenance record.
A Maintenance Technician changes the vehicle status to mark it as available.
A Customer Service Agent responds to passenger complaints and forwards unresolved issues to operations.
A Customer Service Agent reviews lost-and-found submissions and documents items for pickup.
A Transport Planner updates the long-term route plan based on ridership data from operations.
A Transport Planner coordinates with dispatch to introduce temporary detours for construction periods.

associations.description: Dispatcher assigns service tasks with Daily Service Plan.
Dispatcher monitors progress with Scheduled Route.
Dispatcher submits disruption details with Incident Report.
Incident Report notifies Operations Management.
Driver completes service using Scheduled Route.
Driver records delays with Delay Report.
Dispatcher reviews delays using Delay Report.
Driver performs inspection using Pre Trip Check.
Pre Trip Check evaluates Vehicle.
Driver updates Vehicle Status.
Maintenance Technician inspects Vehicle.
Maintenance Technician performs maintenance with Routine Servicing.
Routine Servicing updates Vehicle condition.
Maintenance Technician updates Maintenance Record.
Passenger submits complaint using Customer Complaint.
Customer Service Agent handles Customer Complaint.
Passenger submits Lost And Found Submission.
Customer Service Agent reviews Lost And Found Submission.
Customer Service Agent records items with Item Documentation.
Customer Service Agent escalates Unresolved Issue.
Unresolved Issue alerts Operations Management.
Operations Management provides Ridership Data.
Transport Planner updates Route Plan.
Transport Planner analyzes Ridership Data.
Transport Planner creates Route Alternative.
Route Alternative is communicated to Dispatcher.
